The current low-level goals (LLGs) cover the essential aspects of the parent high-level goal (HLG). They include selecting a pickup time slot, receiving reminders for missed pickups, handling order forfeiture due to non-collection by Friday, and updating the fair-play score based on pickup compliance. Each LLG is well-defined, supported by documented interactions or effects, and does not show redundancy or out-of-scope elements.

The 'Select pickup time slot' (llg_001) corresponds to the customer choosing an available time for product collection, which aligns with the parent's requirement for scheduling. The 'Receive pickup reminder notification' (llg_002) ensures customers are informed before their scheduled pickup time, fulfilling the need for automated reminders.

The 'Receive missed pickup notification' (llg_003) and 'Automatically mark order as forfeited if not collected by Friday' (llg_004) handle situations where customers do not collect their orders on time, enforcing the forfeiture policy. Lastly, the 'Update fair-play score upon forfeit or missed pickup' (llg_005) maintains system reliability by adjusting customer scores based on their compliance with pickup schedules.

No unsupported or misleading LLGs are identified, and all essential capabilities of the parent HLG are covered. The decomposition is complete, supported, and non-redundant.
